newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Tighter vs the bloc.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Tighter vs the bloc.

text.p: The Australian bond market put in a modest outperformance against its dollar bloc partners after a favourable inflation assessment by the Reserve Bank in its quarterly Bulletin.
The RBA said that it expected a good inflation performance in the near-term and saw underlying inflation remaining within its 2.0-3.0 percent target during 1998.
But it also went to great lengths to highlight potential wage growth concerns, and said current pollicy settings were appropriate.
However, there was also some relief that the Bulletin didn't stray too far away from comments made by RBA governor Ian Macfarlane last week, analysts said.

Local activity was fairly subdued reflecting Monday's U.S. holiday, and while the U.S. market gets back into full swing later today when New York opens, there is no major data until Wednesday's January CPI.
U.S. debt saw some profit-taking in Tokyo after Friday's rally on a weak PPI outcome.

Canadian bonds ended flat on Monday ahead of Tuesday's Canadian federal budget, due at 2130 GMT (8.30 a.m. local time on Wednesday), while New Zealand bonds continued their recent underperformance in dull trading.
